best_available_whole_sipp_strategy.cash_rule: Fixed strategic GBP cash weight for GLOBAL_CASH fallback; cash earns broker SIPP rate operationally and accepted GBP cash series in research
best_available_whole_sipp_strategy.cost_assumptions: 20 bp one-way + £3.99 per trade leg historically; live ii platform/product costs added separately
best_available_whole_sipp_strategy.rebalance: After the final valid XLON close of each calendar month; execute at first valid next XLON session within 3 sessions
best_available_whole_sipp_strategy.replacement: SWDA unavailable -> do not buy a discretionary world ETF; allocate affected core to GBP cash until a separately evidenced same-exposure alternate is frozen
